run_merge_traj: run merge_traj.py to merge intermediate checkpoints into a single full trajectory for all adsorbate runs
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_checkpoints_to_trajectory: merge sorted checkpoint vasprun.xml files into a complete ASE trajectory file
read_vasprun_xml: read a vasprun.xml file and construct an ASE trajectory using ase.io.read with vasp-xml format
write_full_trajectory: write the merged full trajectory to a .traj file using ase.io.write
